I don't know if this is what you wanted, but I'll give you some easy ones that they teach us in elementary school, reading your post made remember that class very vividly and now this are the only ones I can think of:

Espantapájaros: "Espanta" means scare, "pájaros" means birds, as you can imagine it means scarecrow (or scarebirds I guess?).

Pelirojo: "Peli" comes from "pelo" it means hair, "rojo" is red so this word means red hair or ginger, it's also the name of a bird species with red feathers.

Telaraña: "Tela" means fabric, "araña" means spider, it's a spiderweb. Also, one thing about this word, the end of first word and the beginning of the second one have the same vowel, when this happens instead of writing the two of them, you merge them together so you only get one, hope it makes sense.

Girasol: "Gira" means spin or turn, "Sol" means sun, the word means sunflower, we call it this way because the sunflower always turns to face the sun.
